attributes.name: Jellyfish Cape
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to succeed at your Constitution or Fortitude check to defeat a bane with the Aquatic trait.

Discard this card to add 1d6 and the Electricity trait to any check to defeat a monster with the Aquatic trait. After playing this card, succeed at a Wisdom or Survival 7 check to recharge it instead of discarding it.
